coverage.method: Ten equally weighted target bands per area. Implemented contributes 1, partial contributes 0.5, and absent contributes 0. Percentages are engineering roadmap estimates, not benchmark accuracy.

areas.label: Knowledge breadth
areas.mainGap: Broad encyclopedic, physical, spatial, narrative, temporal-world, scientific, domain, and multilingual knowledge remain incomplete even though several large typed sources now exist.

bands.label: Lexical and taxonomic knowledge
bands.evidence: Open English WordNet supplies validated lexical and typed relation shards.

bands.label: Event and social commonsense
bands.evidence: ATOMIC supplies provenance-bearing defeasible event tuples and typed continuation evidence.

bands.label: Broad encyclopedic facts
bands.evidence: GeoNames and selected ConceptNet relations answer bounded factual families; SimpleQA shows that coverage is far from encyclopedic.

bands.label: Physical and spatial knowledge
bands.evidence: ConceptNet and world-relations provide reviewed affordance, material, direction, comparison, and transition evidence, but EWoK exposes large missing areas.

bands.label: Kinship and typed social relations
bands.evidence: The CLUTRR package declares typed relation classes, inverses, refinements, and compositions without storing case answers.

bands.label: Narrative and script schemas
bands.evidence: ATOMIC and bounded narrative event frames support continuation evidence; richer goals, causality, conflict, and scripts remain incomplete.

bands.label: Temporal and world-state knowledge
bands.evidence: Discrete histories and authored state-change relations exist; broad temporal-world knowledge and interval facts do not.

bands.label: Scientific and technical knowledge
bands.evidence: No reviewed scientific or technical document corpus has crossed the DS014 and DS018–DS021 compiler gates.

bands.label: User or project domain knowledge
bands.evidence: The canonical compiler exists, but no substantial operator-domain document package is promoted.

bands.label: Multilingual knowledge
bands.evidence: Language Agent translation does not create a multilingual KB.

areas.label: Language coverage
areas.mainGap: Broad interrogatives, unrestricted scope, embedded clauses, direct multilingual parsing, and long natural-language theory compilation remain incomplete.

bands.label: Controlled atomic assertions and direct questions
bands.evidence: Supported class, property, relation, ability, location, WH, and yes/no forms compile to symbolic structures.

bands.label: Movement, possession, and bounded state language
bands.evidence: Movement, acquisition, release, location, and predecessor forms execute with witnesses.

bands.label: Session discourse and reference
bands.evidence: Session entities and bounded salience exist; general coreference remains incomplete.

bands.label: Broad factual interrogatives
bands.evidence: A typed factoid frontend and provider router exist, but the SimpleQA diagnostic still contains many unsupported question forms.

bands.label: Feature grammar and acceptability
bands.evidence: A generic feature grammar spans every BLiMP paradigm but fresh performance remains incomplete.

bands.label: Quantification, negation scope, and modality
bands.evidence: Typed finite formulas and categorical A/E/I/O tasks execute; the ordinary prose parser covers only a narrow subset.

bands.label: Embedded clauses and complex coordination
bands.evidence: No general parser path supports the declared final-stage forms.

bands.label: Direct multilingual parsing
bands.evidence: Assisted translation does not count as direct parsing.

bands.label: Narrative discourse
bands.evidence: A bounded four-sentence narrative compiler exists, but it does not provide unrestricted story understanding.

bands.label: Realization and structured task projection
bands.evidence: Several strict adapters and typed realizers exist; open-ended realization and source-independent theory compilation remain incomplete.

areas.label: Reasoning-mechanism coverage
areas.mainGap: Scalable unrestricted first-order proof search, broad argument comprehension, rule synthesis, complete planning, and mature belief revision remain incomplete. Propositional SAT, finite-domain CSP, declarative qualitative relation closure, point-vector composition, and extent inequalities are implemented with checked witnesses.

bands.label: Indexed retrieval
bands.evidence: Canonical and public indexes support deterministic lookup and query-directed loading.

bands.label: Safe Horn deduction
bands.evidence: Range-restricted rules execute with premise and rule provenance; ProofWriter logical forms validate the path.

bands.label: Finite classical, scalable Boolean, categorical, and finite-model reasoning
bands.evidence: Small finite formulas support exhaustive models, larger propositional theories support verified DPLL certificates or countermodels, categorical A/E/I/O tasks produce opposition, transformation, and syllogistic witnesses, and function-free first-order arguments support independently verified countermodels over a declared finite domain.

bands.label: Discrete state transitions
bands.evidence: bAbI and Entity Tracking execute generic movement, possession, add, remove, and transfer semantics.

bands.label: Temporal reasoning
bands.evidence: One adjacent predecessor method exists; interval algebra and unrestricted temporal projection do not.

bands.label: Induction and defeasible defaults
bands.evidence: Source-policy induction and finite preferred models are explicit and bounded; general nonmonotonic reasoning is not.

bands.label: Abduction
bands.evidence: A guarded bounded hypothesis path exists; broad explanatory and narrative abduction does not.

bands.label: Typed relation and spatial composition
bands.evidence: Typed relation algebra, declarative qualitative closure with selective containment lifting, exact point-vector constraints, and extent inequalities execute through the runtime with replayable witnesses. The methods remain explicit finite calculi rather than unrestricted geometric theorem proving.

bands.label: Constraint, SAT, and CSP solving
bands.evidence: Tseitin-CNF and deterministic DPLL produce verified assignments, conflict certificates, countermodels, and finite-domain all-different solutions with uniqueness checks. CDCL, optimization, broad mixed-domain CSP, and unrestricted first-order search remain absent.

bands.label: Planning, conflict, and method composition
bands.evidence: Capability descriptors, explicit plans, and bounded preference semantics exist; complete AND/OR planning and belief revision do not.
